text:
It was really easy to give my Grok @bot a phone number using the bland service, I purchased a phone number for $15, gave my bot the the API key and it works out the rest.

Now I can just ask it to call someone with some instructions and it does it, has the conversation and reports back how the call went and it provides the call recording audio if I ask for it. It was even able to take a 10 second recording of my voice and create a new voice using that which sounded like me. I can also call the bland number and leave a voicemail which the grok bot hears and adds to the chat.

All of this just asking my bot, no setup beyond providing the API key.
